title: Bug: loganalyzer crash with `Exception: pop from empty list`
author: rajkumar1-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

Loganalyzer is crashing with

Exception:
    | pop from empty list
    | Traceback:
    | Traceback (most recent call last):
    |   File "/data/tests/common/helpers/parallel.py", line 36, in run
    |     Process.run(self)
    |   File "/usr/lib/python3.8/multiprocessing/process.py", line 108, in run
    |     self._target(*self._args, **self._kwargs)
    |   File "/data/tests/common/helpers/parallel.py", line 268, in wrapper
    |     target(*args, **kwargs)
    |   File "/data/tests/common/plugins/loganalyzer/__init__.py", line 52, in analyze_logs
    |     dut_analyzer.analyze(markers[node.hostname], fail_test, store_la_logs=store_la_logs)
    |   File "/data/tests/common/plugins/loganalyzer/loganalyzer.py", line 390, in analyze
    |     analyzer_parse_result = self.ansible_loganalyzer.analyze_file_list(
    |   File "/data/tests/common/plugins/loganalyzer/system_msg_handler.py", line 571, in analyze_file_list
    |     match_strings, expect_strings = self.analyze_file(log_file, match_messages_regex, ignore_messages_regex,
    |   File "/data/tests/common/plugins/loganalyzer/system_msg_handler.py", line 489, in analyze_file
    |     marker_run_id = ignore_marker_run_ids.pop()
    | IndexError: pop from empty list

### Steps to Reproduce

Just raise exceptions like `pytest_assert` etc in function (ex: `config_reload` ) wrapped by `support_ignore_loganalyzer` wrapper.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

This should not crash.

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix loganalyzer crash with `Exception: pop from empty list`
linkedPullRequests.author: rajkumar1-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixing `support_ignore_loganalyzer` wrapper to add `end_ignore_mark` in case of exceptions as well.
for example: In `config_reload`, if we get any pytest_assert failure, which will cause `end_ignore_marker` to not get added, leading to this crash during further processing in loganalyzer.
